```{r Read the files}

Grp1 <- read.csv("/path_to_folder/Group1_transcript_density.csv")
Grp2 <- read.csv("/path_to_folder/Group2_transcript_density.csv")
sen <- read.csv("/path_to_Folder/combined_genelist_for_senescent_Bcells.csv")
genes <- sen$Genes
```

```{r Heatmap}
# Filter
filtered_grp1 <- Grp1[Grp1$Gene %in% genes, ]
filtered_grp2 <- Grp2[Grp2$Gene%in% genes, ]

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Create gene x sample matrix
gene_matrix_grp1 <-  filtered_grp1%>%
  select(Gene, Sample, Density_normalized) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = Density_normalized
  )
gene_matrix_grp2 <-  filtered_grp2%>%
  select(Gene, Sample, Density_normalized) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = Density_normalized
  )

write.csv(gene_matrix_ns, "/path_to_folder/gene_density_matrix_grp1.csv")
write.csv(gene_matrix_c, "/Upath_to_folder/gene_density_matrix_grp2.csv")

```

```{r z scoring of the data}
# Convert to data frames/matrices
grp1_mat <- as.data.frame(gene_matrix_grp1)
grp2_mat <- as.data.frame(gene_matrix_grp2)

# Set Gene as row names
rownames(grp1_mat) <- grp1_mat$Gene
grp1_mat$Gene <- NULL

rownames(grp2_mat) <- grp2_mat$Gene
grp2_mat$Gene <- NULL

# Keep genes present in BOTH datasets
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(grp1_mat), rownames(grp2_mat))

grp1_mat <- grp1_mat[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
grp2_mat <- grp2_mat[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# Combine grp1 and grp2 samples
combined_mat <- cbind(grp1_mat, grp2_mat)

# --------------------------------
# LOG2 TRANSFORMATION
# --------------------------------

combined_log2 <- log2(combined_mat + 1)

# --------------------------------
# Z-SCORE EACH GENE
# across ALL NS + COPD samples
# --------------------------------

combined_z <- t(scale(t(combined_log2)))

# Convert back to data frame
combined_z <- as.data.frame(combined_z)

# Put Gene back as a column
combined_z$Gene <- rownames(combined_z)

# Move Gene to first column
combined_z <- combined_z %>%
  select(Gene, everything())

write.csv(combined_z, "/path_to_folder/Z-score_grp2_v_grp1.csv")

```
